احدودقوا (form XII)
# اِحْدَوْدَقُوا (iḥdawdaqū) /iħ.daw.da.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
# اِحْدَوْدِقُوا (iḥdawdiqū) /iħ.daw.di.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
